issues.description: Method visibility mismatch for Animal.messageOnFeed(): The UML in problem_statement.md declares messageOnFeed() as public abstract (marked with '+') while the reference solution declares it as protected abstract (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java line 18). This inconsistency can confuse students about the intended access level (whether implementations and external callers should expect a public API) and which visibility they must use when implementing the abstract method in subclasses.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either change the solution declaration to public: "public abstract String messageOnFeed();" in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java, or update the UML/problem statement to show messageOnFeed() as protected if package/subclass-restricted access was intended. Update any tests or documentation accordingly so students have a single, unambiguous expectation.
